paragraphs.text: Eternal is a creature type introduced for Marvel Super Heroes . It is used to represent an artificial species created as an immortal offshoot of humanity with extraordinary abilities and powers who have looked after humanity throughout the ages in the Marvel Universe .

Eternal is a Marvel Universes Beyond crossover type. Eternals, also known as Homo immortalis , are a group of 100 humanoids created by the Celestials millions of years ago after they discovered early humans. Eternals appear as humans but are immortal with superhuman powers. Thanos is notably a mutated Eternal with Deviant Syndrome caused by Deviant genes - Deviants being another species created by the Celestials.
